scenicChapters.title: Fort site of Burgsalach → Watchtowers WP 15/1 to 15/7
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 35 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Fort site of Eining-Unterfeld → Regensburg Großprüfening - Kastell und
scenicChapters.narrative: 35 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it. Speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.

places-fort-site-of-burgsalach-straubing.story: 332 km from Burgsalach to Burgsalach, about 5 h 43 of riding. It goes by way of Watchtowers WP 15/1 to 15/7, Fort site of Eining-Unterfeld, Regensburg Großprüfening - Kastell und Vic and Straubing - Kastell St. Peter. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

The highest point is about 1,300 m. Aurlandsfjellet high point is open in summer only - check it is open before you set off. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
